scenes.title: £139 a night for a 3-bed Airbnb in Jamaica
scenes.vo: A hundred and thirty-nine pounds a night. That's what a three-bed Airbnb in Jamaica typically charges. A two-bed? Eighty-six.
That's sixty-one percent more per night, from over eighteen hundred live two and three-bed Airbnb listings across the island.
In US dollars, that's about a hundred and eighty-six a night, against a hundred and fifteen.

scenes.desc: Typical asking price, 3-bed vs 2-bed in Jamaica
scenes.vo: But the typical asking price is only about twenty percent higher, at around two hundred and twenty-one thousand pounds.
That's gross, before costs. A bigger place means more cleaning, more utilities and more wear.
